anime-mcp.title: Anime MCP
anime-mcp.summary: Building an MCP server for anime-character search, with a focus on retrieval quality and combining lexical and embedding scores.
anime-mcp.currentFocus: Identify retrieval bottlenecks and select embedding models for hybrid-fusion experiments.
anime-mcp.nextStep: Select the embedding models, run hybrid-fusion experiments, and compare the results with published findings.
anime-mcp.currentBlocker: The retrieval bottleneck has not yet been identified. Model selection and comparative experiments are needed to investigate it.

evaluation-and-lexical-foundation.title: Develop the evaluation and lexical-retrieval foundation
evaluation-and-lexical-foundation.description: Build the evaluation setup and lexical-retrieval baseline for comparing retrieval approaches.

select-embedding-models.title: Select embedding models
select-embedding-models.description: Model names and the final comparison set are pending.

run-hybrid-fusion-experiments.title: Run hybrid-fusion experiments
run-hybrid-fusion-experiments.description: Evaluate retrieval performance and investigate where bottlenecks appear.

interpret-experiment-results.title: Compare findings with published research
interpret-experiment-results.description: Examine whether the findings extend to anime retrieval and document differences supported by the experiments. Results are not yet available.

current-research-focus.text: The current priority is understanding retrieval bottlenecks and preparing an embedding-model comparison with hybrid fusion. Model selection and experimental results are pending.

linkLabels.https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.11934: Research reference: An Analysis of Fusion Functions for Hybrid Retrieval

gba-website.title: GBA-style personal website
gba-website.summary: A nearly finished personal website with a Game Boy Advance-style experience and A/B controls, running in the browser.
gba-website.currentFocus: Finish the remaining houses, correct character spawning, and improve the existing gameplay.
gba-website.nextStep: Add friends' houses, fix incorrect spawn locations, and refine the current gameplay.

finish-website-experience.title: Finish the browser-based website experience
finish-website-experience.description: The existing experience is nearly complete, with a small set of additions and fixes remaining.

fix-spawn-locations.title: Correct character spawn locations
fix-spawn-locations.description: Ensure characters do not appear at the wrong location.

website-final-additions.text: The website is nearly finished. Remaining work includes friends' houses, spawn-location fixes, and improvements to the current gameplay. The related browser game builds on this work.

browser-game.title: Browser game
browser-game.summary: A game growing out of the GBA-style website, with plans for expanded gameplay, NPC behavior, character classes, and offline play with local saves.
browser-game.currentFocus: Design the first version of NPC logic. Its actions are not currently organized as a state machine.
browser-game.nextStep: Continue developing the NPC logic independently before deciding on the broader implementation approach.

design-npc-logic-v1.title: Design NPC logic v1
design-npc-logic-v1.description: Initial action logic is being designed. The current version is not a state machine.

develop-typescript-gameplay.title: Develop expanded gameplay in TypeScript
develop-typescript-gameplay.description: Build on the website's browser-based foundation and GBA-style controls.

enable-offline-play.title: Enable offline play
enable-offline-play.description: The goal is a free game playable locally without a game server.

add-save-file-import-export.title: Add local saves and save-file import/export
add-save-file-import-export.description: Players should be able to keep their progress and load it again. The storage method and file format have not been selected.

npc-design-underway.text: NPC logic design has started. The first version uses actions that are not yet a state machine. Offline play, character classes, expanded gameplay, and save-file import/export remain planned work.

gluonagent.title: GluonAgent
gluonagent.summary: An agent project paused while its complexity and research needs are reassessed.
gluonagent.nextStep: Do further research before deciding how to resume the project.
gluonagent.currentBlocker: The project's complexity requires more research before development can continue.

further-research.title: Research the unresolved complexity
further-research.description: Further research is needed before the project resumes.
